findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the hand washing sink in the infant room to contain a paintbrush in the sink basin. CORRECTED- the paint brush was removed from the sink. Ensure hand washing sinks are used for hand washing only. A blocked sink/ a sink used for other purposes may deter frequent hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed ambient thermometer to be missing from the refrigerator in the infant room. CORRECTED- an ambient thermometer was placed in the door. Ensure all cold holding units contain an ambient thermometer placed in the warmest part of the unit to ensure temperature control for food safety (TCS) foods are held at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: Inspector observed handle of serving utensil in the oranges. Gloves are worn when serving but still food must be protected from the handle. The serving time was at the end. Breakfast is from 8:30am to 10am. The few oranges remaining were discarded. The kitchen staff was reminded of the rule. They said that they usually use a smaller bowl and the handle does not usually does not come into contact with the food. 

FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

Mouse droppings are present on the counter behind the microwave and on the window sill. The facility has cleaned and sanitized the area. Maintain the area free of droppings. The facility caught a mouse on Monday, 10/9/23.  The inspector will be back to follow up on 10/23/23.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

Mouse soil observed on the counter behind the microwave and the window sill. The area was cleaned and sanitized at time of inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

Mice droppings still present on bottom dry storage shelves and behind fridge. Clean and sanitized. Inspector will follow-up on 4/22/22.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: Facility will be followed up on next week;. Mouse problem is noted throughout the facility Sentinel is coming on Monday 4/18.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. The coving in the employee bathroom is coming away from the wall - re-seal.
2. Caulk is needed at the hand sinks near the kitchen. No caulk was observed between the sink and wall.

Ensure repairs before next routine inspection. Discussed with PIC. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 4/8/21.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements - out of compliance. Reviewed document with PIC's. Discussed importance and need for all food handler's to sign - retain documents in public health folder. Provided paperwork for requirements for diagnosed food service employees and requirements for symptomatic employees for reporting, exclusion, and restriction. Reviewed documents. Paperwork was noted as given during last routine inspection - 3/11/19. Inspector will follow-up on 04/19/21.

findings.title: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use
findings.comment:
2-401.11: (A) EMPLOYEE SHALL eat, drink, or use tobacco in designated areas away from FOOD and FOOD-RELATED areas. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEE may drink from closed BEVERAGE Container if handled to prevent: (1) hands (2) container (3) FOOD and FOOD-RELATED ITEMS. 

Observed open beverage can in the kitchen. Beverages should have a closed lid. Discussed practice with PIC and food handler. COS.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

(REPEAT) Observed no hand washing between tasks by the food handler. In between tasks, hands should be washed in a hank sink with soap, hot water, and paper towels. A barrier to turn off the faucet should be used such as the paper towel. Discussion was held with PIC's and the food handler. COS. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 3/11/19.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser. 

Observed basket of single-use spoons to not be prewrapped or stored in a manner that allows handles being touched by employees inappropriately. Handles are stored in both directions allowing access to touch food- and lip-contact surfaces - cross contamination. Cease practice. Store single-use utensils in a manner that allows access to only handles without touching food- and lip-contact surfaces when retrieving items.

Observed pots and cooking utensils in the stove area to be stored in a manner that allows access to cross contamination - invert pots and cooking utensils on top shelf. 

Discussed practices with PIC's.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. The shelving boards that are storing the pots and cooking utensils within the stove area need repainted.
2. The shelf by the 3 compartment sink is in need of being repainted.
3. The coving in the employee bathroom is coming away from the wall - re seal
4. Caulk is needed at the hand sinks near the kitchen. No caulk was observed between the sink and wall. 

Discussed repairs with PIC.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-202.11: Light bulbs shall be shielded, coated or otherwise shatter-resistant in certain areas. 

Observed no light shield for lighting within the stove area. Discussed purchasing light shield with PIC's.
